posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
First off, I know this should probably go in off-topic, but it's really time-sensitive, and relatively few people read the off-topic forums -- I know I don't. Anyway, it recently came to my attention that a certain item will be available for purchase at GenCon, and it's a limited run, so unfortunately that means I won't be able to get it...

 

unless someone is willing to pick it up for me. I'll pay anyone back, of course. Just send me a PM if you're willing. Please, I really want this.
